title: CLCON/144/2015 of Ramnath Tiwari Vs Dheeraj Singh Garbyal

paras.text:
CLCON No.144 of 2015
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
(via Video Conferencing)
Mr. Mohit Kumar, Advocate holding brief of
Mr. K.S. Bora, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Vipul Sharma, Advocate for the respondent.
The petitioner had filed this writ petition seeking
compliance of the judgment dated 21.01.2015 as
passed by the learned Single Judge in Writ Petition
(S/S) No.1329 of 2012, Ramnath Tiwari vs. Secretary
Agricultural (Production) Government of Uttarakhand
and Others.
The Coordinate Bench of this Court while
deciding the writ petition has passed the following
directions:-
"6. Therefore, the writ petition is disposed of
with the direction to the Managing Director,
Uttarakhand Agriculture Marketing Board
(Uttarakhand Krishi Utpadan Mandi Parishad),
to consider the case of the petitioner, particularly
in the light of the fact that the Mandi Parishad is
granting wages to its work charge employees by
adopting the wages being given to the employees
in Public Works Department. He shall consider
the representation of the petitioner and if need
be, in consultation with the State Government to
grant the benefit as being sought by the
petitioner, in view of the fact that there is no
independent provision for granting such benefit
to its employees in the Mandi Parishad."
Alleging its non compliance, the contempt
petition was filed on 20.05.2015. Notices were issued
to the respondents later on, they had filed the response
affidavit and subsequently, this contempt petition was
dismissed as having rendered infructuous by the
judgment of the Coordinate Bench dated 21.03.2016,

on the ground that the order stands complied with.
Later on, a recall application was preferred by the
petitioner. The said order was recalled and the
contempt petition revived to its original number.
The respondents have filed a supplementary
counter affidavit annexing therewith various
correspondences, which they have made with the State
Government with regards to resolving the issue
pertaining to grant of the benefit of the work charge
establishment in the Krishi Utpatan Mandi Samiti. The
Managing Director has specifically passed an order
after consultation with the State Government that is the
Mandi Samiti, there happens to be no work charge
establishment as such. Consequently, the claim of the
petitioner had been rejected on this ground by an order
passed by the respondents, which is appended with the
supplementary counter affidavit.
In view of the aforesaid correspondence made by
the Managing Director Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti
and in the light of the directions issued by the
Coordinate Bench of this Court to pass an appropriate
order after consultation with the State for the grant of
the benefit of the work charge establishment and the
scale payable thereof has been complied with,
consequently, the contempt petition is closed. Notices
issued to the respondents are discharged.
However, the closure of the contempt petition
will not prejudice the right of the petitioner to seek his
appropriate remedy if available to him under the law,
as against the decision taken by the respondents
appended with the supplementary counter affidavit.
Subject to the aforesaid, the contempt petition is
closed.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 24.08.2020
